password.digit-required: The password must include a digit.
password.lowercase-required: The password must include a lowercase letter.
password.symbol-required: The password must include a punctuation mark or a symbol.
password.too-long: The password must be at most {{max}} characters long.
password.too-short: The password must be at least {{min}} characters long.
password.uppercase-required: The password must include an uppercase letter.
